decisiveDriverExcerpt:
sa=state('a');sb=state('b');check(sa['document']==sb['document'],'cross-machine recovered document equality');check(sa['status']['replicaId']!=sb['status']['replicaId'],'distinct durable replica identities')
 commit('b','Network B '+SUFFIX)
 wait('b',lambda s:s['status']['sync']['kind']=='paused' and s['status']['sync'].get('reason') in ['lease_held','deadline_exceeded'],'second-machine publisher lease contention')
 call('a','disconnect',{});call('b','connect',{})
 wait('b',lambda s:s['status']['pending']==0 and s['status']['sync']['kind']=='caught_up','second-machine lease handoff published')
 call('a','connect',{});wait('a',lambda s:s['document']==state('b')['document'],'cross-machine complete document convergence')
 REC['networkPassed']=True
 # Backend outage proof through the same ordinary service endpoints.
 call('a','disconnect',{});call('b','disconnect',{})
 run(['docker','pause',CONTAINER]);paused=True
 mutation=commit('b','Outage saved '+SUFFIX);check(mutation['receipt']['status']=='locally_saved' and mutation['state']['status']['pending']>0,'backend unavailable local edit durably saved with pending work')
 call('b','connect',{});failed=wait('b',lambda s:s['status']['sync']['kind']=='paused','unavailable backend reports paused state')
 check(failed['status']['pending']>0,'outage does not falsely clear pending publication')
 run(['docker','unpause',CONTAINER]);paused=False;call('b','connect',{})
 wait('b',lambda s:s['status']['pending']==0 and s['status']['sync']['kind']=='caught_up','publication recovers after backend resumes')
 call('a','connect',{});wait('a',lambda s:s['document']==state('b')['document'],'peer converges after backend outage')
 REC['outagePassed']=True
